item_short_desc: Griffin’s Water & Stain Repellent provides advanced protection for military personnel, law enforcement, and first responders who work in rain, snow, mud, and high-traffic environments. This high-performance spray shields your footwear and gear from water, dirt, debris, and everyday stains, helping maintain a sharp, inspection-ready appearance in all conditions. Safe for all colors and materials, the shoe care spray won’t darken leather, suede, or nubuck. The repellent spray is ideal for tactical boots, uniform shoes, and everyday footwear.
